contentPattern: One row per video card. Cell 1: poster image (thumbnail). Cell 2: video URL link (YouTube, Vimeo or an mp4/webm file). Cell 3: rich text - video title/caption. Clicking the poster swaps it for the player.
usage: Grid of 2-3 video cards with a thumbnail, play button and caption (how-to and safety tip videos).
reuseGuidance: Use for galleries of video thumbnails with captions that play inline. For a single large video use the video or embed block.
